answer: Propose an AI archive of sparrow calls, sonnet readings and canyon scans. One vote per key per 30-day round requires a distinct 1-GB key-bound, slow-encoded replica throughout. Validators check replication proofs and timed random chunk audits; failed checks cancel that round's vote. The space bound assumes absent chunks cannot be recomputed before the deadline. Disks are reusable capital; power or rent recurs; no stake is locked. Wealth buys aliases, but ten keys on shared, rented or parallel hosts still need 10 GB: 300 GB-days per round.
